title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler Defends Opponent
items.text: Scottie Scheffler confronted a spectator to defend his Presidents Cup opponent during the 2026 event at Medinah Country Club.

items.headline: Bryson Keeps Tour Return Hopes
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau’s potential PGA Tour return remains uncertain following Brooks Koepka’s January comeback.

items.headline: Kai Trump Injured
items.text: Kai Trump, President Trump's granddaughter and University of Miami golf scholar, is treating a wrist injury suffered in her first tournament.
